description: Check whether AI assistants and answer engines may read a site: its robots.txt rules for 20+ AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended…) and the search crawlers answers rely on, Content-Signals, an llms.txt, a Markdown version of the page, snippet rules, structured data and text readable without JavaScript. Fetches the page, robots.txt and llms.txt as our crawler after robots.txt; stores nothing. at most 20 checks an hour per network and 30 an hour per site checked.

url.description: The public page to check (https://…). A bare host means its homepage.

name: check_ai_visibility

checks.description: Fails first. `fix` is the one action to take; null on a pass.

facts.description: What was read, as labelled rows. From the site or a registry: unverified.

listing.description: Whether the site is listed on the directory: its page when it is, where to list it when not.

toolUrl.description: The same check as a page on the site.

title: Check AI visibility
